prompts.name: 绿茵日常
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: portrait background for a Chinese amateur football team's personal annual participation honor share poster, 1024x1536, 2:3. This is ONLY the empty reusable background, not a finished poster or UI mockup. Composition: reserve the middle 72% width and top 78% height as very calm low-contrast negative space where software will later overlay avatar, nickname, team, score and awards. Keep bottom center clear for a QR code panel. Sports-themed decoration concentrated near edges and lower corners, refined premium editorial sports aesthetic. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, people, crowns, trophies, badges, QR codes, placeholders, framed cards, panels or phone mockups. Full bleed background. Palette: airy warm ivory and pale mint with gentle deep-green accents confined to outermost corners. Stylized football pitch geometry, thin elegant boundary and center-circle hints along bottom edges, subtle organic grass grain, soft morning sun. Flat refined illustration with restrained paper texture. The entire central area remains uniform very pale mint/ivory for dark text readability. Welcoming, relaxed team spirit.
